Description: Your computer's volume and level on your Stream Deck.
Name: System Audio Controller

Localization.The computer's volume on a dial, with th: The computer's volume on a dial, with the level of what is playing.

key.choose_app_hint: In the settings of this dial

pi.preset_long_press_hint: Hold the key half a second for this volume.
pi.show_player_name_hint: The player's name on the key
pi.show_title_hint: Title and artist scroll across the key
pi.show_progress_hint: A bar in the cover's colour
pi.app_output_help: Press: the apps play on the next device of the list (e.g. headset → speakers → Windows default). Windows keeps it for the app; an app that is closed gets it when it starts.
pi.no_apps: No apps with sound right now. Start one, then open this again.
pi.output_targets_hint: One row per step. "Windows default" plays the app where Windows plays everything.
pi.output_help: Rotate: volume · Push or tap: mute. Shows the default output device.
pi.title: Name
pi.no_apps: No app is playing sound right now. Start it, then open this list again.
pi.app_help: Rotate: the app's volume · Push or tap: mute. The app's volume is relative to the output volume, like in the Windows volume mixer.
pi.mic_help: Press: mute or unmute the microphone (the default input). The level moves only while an app records, e.g. during a call.
pi.device_help: Press: make this device the default. With a second device, a press switches between the two.
pi.app_key_help: Press: mute or unmute the app. The key shows the app's icon; red while muted, grey while the app isn't running.
pi.duck_none: No other plugin on deckbus right now.
pi.duck_hint: Plugins switched on here may lower your computer's volume for a moment, e.g. MA-C during an announcement. SA-C puts the volume back afterwards; if you change it in the meantime, yours stays.

Localization.One app's volume on a dial (Spotify, Fir: One app's volume on a dial (Spotify, Firefox, …), with its level.
Localization.Mute the microphone. Clearly red while m: Mute the microphone. Clearly red while muted.
Localization.Switch the default output device, e.g. h: Switch the default output device, e.g. headphones and speakers.
Localization.Play apps on another device (Discord on: Play apps on another device (Discord on the headset, Spotify on the speakers).
Localization.Mute one app (Spotify, Discord, …) with: Mute one app (Spotify, Discord, …) with a key that shows its icon.
